summary.text: Christy Cardwell is the Democratic candidate for West Virginia State Senate District 9 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Rollan Roberts.
An educator with nearly 28 years of classroom experience, she ran for the same seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Christy Cardwell graduated from Mullens High School and earned a graduate degree from West Virginia University in 2000; her career experience includes working as an educator.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a married mother of four, a teacher with nearly 28 years in the classroom, a coal miner's daughter and granddaughter, and a 27-year union member.
Cardwell was the Democratic nominee for West Virginia State Senate District 9 in 2024, when she lost the general election to Republican Brian Helton, 75.0 percent to 25.0 percent.
She advanced from the May 12, 2026 Democratic primary to run again.

In the survey, she said legislators have focused on culture war issues rather than kitchen-table issues, and she listed public education, affordable child care, a safe foster care system and clean drinking water as her key messages.
She named Education West Virginia and the West Virginia AFL-CIO as endorsers.
